## Description

Add skills/analyze-sessions/SKILL.md. It is user-invoked (disable-model-invocation true) and short. Steps: run scripts/session_report.py --records and scripts/session_aggregate.py; read caveats first; find patterns; read targets.md to map each to a target; optionally read one named session transcript with bounded reads; present candidates most severe first, each with its metric and session references; propose only and edit nothing until the user picks. Scripts are found two levels above SKILL.md. It carries no store-writing command. Waits on targets.md.
record.subject: as-skill
